description: Resolve free-text drug wording (brand or generic, English or Spanish) to the canonical LowerScript/RxSense drug: its known dosage forms, strengths, and a typical fill quantity. Cost/availability lookup only — never a substitute drug, never a dose recommendation, never priced (use get_prices for a price). Returns a "try another name" message when nothing matches.

query.description: Drug name in English or Spanish, brand or generic (e.g. "metformin", "Ozempic", "amoxicilina").

name: find_drug
title: Find a drug
